highlights.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
highlights.summary: Argus is a general-purpose agentic runtime for long-horizon reasoning.
highlights.detail: Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives and admits memories and skills after review. It achieves high performance on benchmark arenas.

highlights.title: ArtAnno: Annotating Implicit Semantics in Artworks through LLM Agent-Driven Bidirectional Human-AI Augmentation
highlights.summary: ArtAnno is an artwork annotation system driven by a multi-agent architecture.
highlights.detail: ArtAnno uses Bidirectional Human-AI Augmentation to evolve skills and domain knowledge base through real-time interaction.

highlights.title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
highlights.summary: SparseDitto is an LLM-based system for customizing GPU kernels.
highlights.detail: SparseDitto constructs a GPU kernel for each matrix, operator, and target GPU, supporting SpMV, SpMM, and SpGEMM.

highlights.title: Accelerating C/C++ Pointer Analysis via Compiler-Based Offline Simplifications
highlights.summary: Compiler-based offline simplifications accelerate pointer analysis
highlights.detail: The approach applies semantic-preserving compiler optimizations to intermediate representation.

highlights.title: Born Against, or why hobby programming communities are against LLM usage
highlights.summary: Hobby programming communities are against LLM usage.
highlights.detail: The community's stance on LLM usage is driven by concerns about dependency and lack of control.
